contexts.text: Because there is nothing internal in them (these Knowledges) are called seed of Sihor ().
The waters of Sihor () = scientifics which pervert. ( = false scientifics, or scientifics which confirm falsities. AE 518:37.)

What hast thou to do with the way of Egypt that thou mayest drink the waters of Sihor () = what with falsities induced by scientifics perversely applied. ( = to investigate spiritual things by means of the scientifics of the natural man. AE 569:16.) ( = instruction solely from the natural man, whence are mere falsities. AE 654:60.)
